 Posted Nov 18, 2026 at 8:12 PM UTC R Youtube Richard Lawler The full GTA VI graphics breakdown on PS5 Pro, PS5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S. We finally have more details about GTA VI’s graphics, including that it’s upscaling 1440p to 4K on base PS5 and Xbox Series X, but PSSR2 on the PS5 Pro.
 AMD’s FSR Upscaling 4 is used to scale the resolution from 720p to 1080p on Series S. Digital Foundry explains how input lag factored into those choices, as well as the differences between platforms , how well it holds to the target 30fps framerate, plus the impact of VRR.
